documents.title: Price adjustment
documents.text:
To: Accounts Team
From: Gordon Pike, Pike Packaging
Date: August 12

Dear valued customer,
Due to a rise in the cost of recycled cardboard, we will be adjusting our prices by 6 percent beginning October 1. Orders confirmed before September 15 will be honored at current prices, even if delivery takes place after October 1. We recommend that customers with seasonal needs place their holiday orders early to take advantage of this arrangement. Our shipping rates and payment terms will not change. If you have any questions, please contact your account representative.
Thank you for your continued business.

questions.explanation: Prices will rise by 6 percent starting October 1.

It will be charged at the current prices
questions.explanation: Orders confirmed before September 15 keep current prices.

questions.prompt: Why does Mr. Pike suggest ordering holiday supplies early?
questions.explanation: Early orders are protected from the October increase.

documents.title: Strong suction, weak battery
documents.text:
Zephyr Cordless Vacuum: 4 stars out of 5
Posted by Dev S., verified buyer

I bought the Zephyr Cordless Vacuum two months ago to replace my old corded model. Setup took just a few minutes, and the suction is impressive; it picks up pet hair from my carpets better than any vacuum I've owned. It is also light enough for my elderly mother to use. My only complaint is the battery, which lasts about 25 minutes, less than the 40 minutes advertised. A spare battery costs $55, which feels expensive. Customer service replied quickly to my question about filters, though. I would recommend it to anyone with a small apartment, but not to those with large homes.

It is cheaper than other models

documents.title: Weekly Market Moves to Town Square
documents.text: OAKDALE (September 20) - Starting next month, the Oakdale Farmers Market will move from the Fairgrounds to Town Square. [A] The market, which has operated every Saturday for 15 years, will now take place on Sundays from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. [B] Organizer Fran Delaney said the new location is closer to public transportation and will allow more shoppers to attend. "We lose many customers because the fairgrounds are hard to reach without a car," she said. [C] The change also means that the market will be able to operate during winter, since Town Square has a covered pavilion. [D] About 60 vendors are expected to participate, including a new bakery and two honey producers. The first market in the new location will be held on October 6.

questions.prompt: What does the article report?
choices: A vendor has won an award
A weekly market is changing its location and day
questions.explanation: The market moves from the Fairgrounds to Town Square and from Saturdays to Sundays.

questions.prompt: Why is the new location considered better?
choices: It has lower fees for vendors
It is easier to reach without a car
It is larger than the fairgrounds
It is closer to the farms
questions.explanation: Ms. Delaney says it is closer to public transportation.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the market's current schedule?
choices: It does not usually run in winter

It already has a covered area
questions.explanation: The move will let the market operate in winter, which implies it cannot at the fairgrounds.

questions.prompt: In which position marked [A], [B], [C] or [D] does the following sentence best belong? "Shoppers will therefore be able to buy local food all year."
questions.explanation: 'Therefore' follows the sentence about winter operation made possible by the pavilion.

documents.title: Volunteer Coordinator (part-time)
documents.text: Riverbend Food Bank, which serves 4,000 families each month, is looking for a part-time Volunteer Coordinator. The coordinator will recruit and schedule volunteers, lead training sessions, and report monthly volunteer hours to the executive director. Candidates should have experience in nonprofit work and strong organizational skills; knowledge of Spanish is a plus. The position is 20 hours per week, with some Saturday shifts, and pays $23 per hour. Applicants should send a résumé and two references to jobs@riverbendfb.example. Interviews will begin on the first of next month. This position is open until filled.

documents.title: Offer of employment
documents.text:
Corvin Media
June 5

Dear Mr. Singh,
Following your interviews on June 3 and 10, I am pleased to offer you the position of Marketing Analyst, starting Monday, July 15. Your annual salary will be $62,000, paid monthly. You will report to Ms. Laura Chen, Head of Marketing. Your first three months are a probationary period. Please sign and return the enclosed copy of this letter by June 21 to confirm your acceptance. Details of our benefits program are described in the attached memo.
Sincerely,
Paul Duval
HR Director

documents.text:

Dear Mr. Duval,
Thank you for the offer, which I am delighted to accept. I will return the signed letter by courier tomorrow. I have two questions. First, would it be possible to start on July 22 instead? I have a family commitment during the week of July 15. Second, the memo mentions a relocation allowance. I currently live about 200 kilometers from your office and intend to move in August. Would I qualify even though I would not move before starting?
Ravi Singh

documents.title: Harvest Festival Returns
documents.text: MILLBROOK (September 4) - The Millbrook Harvest Festival returns this year for its 12th edition on September 20 to 22 at Riverfront Park. Admission is free, though some activities require tickets. Highlights include a pie-baking contest, a craft market with more than 80 stalls, and, new this year, a Saturday evening concert by the local band Copper Road. Organizers expect 15,000 visitors and are encouraging attendees to use the free shuttle from Millbrook Station, since parking near the park will be limited. Volunteers are still needed; those interested should contact the festival office.

Sunday, Sept. 22: 11:00 a.m. Parade; 1:00 p.m. Dog show; 4:00 p.m. Closing ceremony and prize announcements
Shuttle: every 15 minutes from Millbrook Station, 9:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

documents.title: Water Service Interruption
documents.text: The City Water Department will shut off water to buildings on Cedar Lane (numbers 100 to 180) on Wednesday, April 17, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. to replace an aging main pipe. Residents are advised to store drinking water in advance. Water may appear cloudy for a few hours after service is restored; running cold water for several minutes will clear it. Businesses that require water for food preparation should contact the department at 555-0111 to request a temporary supply.
